thread:
Anya: FYI Mariposa Labs onboarding — noticed tail latency spikes on >1k token prompts this week. Renewal in ~6w. I think we should propose a proactive perf plan: int8 quant + model swap to compact-variant for heavy routes + routing policy for short vs long prompts. Suggestions? :thinking:

Leo: digging into logs now. 99th went from 1.2s -> 3.9s during peak. Most of their traffic is long-form summarization (>1k tokens). We can batch better but that'll increase latency.

Sam: quick eval on their prompt set looks promising for int8. Quality drop negligible on summarization tests (ROUGE delta ~0.6). INT8 -> 1.7x throughput, 20-30% cost savings in our sim.

Leo: good. My main worry is the first-token latency on compact variants. We can do a staggered canary: route 10% of long prompts to compact-int8, monitor p95/p99, and fallback.

Maria: I'll own customer comms + enablement docs. Proposed rollout: canary Mon->Wed next week, expand Thu if metrics stable. Need eng checklist and a short eval deck for Mariposa.

Sam: here is a draft routing rule to gate by prompt length:
```json
{
  "route": "compact-int8",
  "condition": "prompt_tokens > 512",
  "percentage": 10
}
```

Leo: also add KV-prefix caching for repeated conversation context — that shaved 15% off tokens for a different customer.

Anya: capture risks: quality regression, unexpected error surface, fallback flapping. Renewal conversation should mention measured perf gains and trial canary.

Maria: customer prefers low risk; offer 2-week free pilot on compact-int8 variant and share rollback plan. I'll draft email.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled by eng on 1744520000. Alerting: create monitors for p50/p95/p99 latency and error-rate >0.5%.

Leo: assigning tasks: Sam: run final eval suite and produce 1-pg result. Me: implement routing rule + caching. Maria: customer comms + pilot terms. Anya: renewal touchpoint draft.

Anya: thanks — quick sync 2pm today? I'll create calendar invite. :calendar:

Maria: 2pm works. I'll bring the pilot terms.

Sam: noted. prepping evals now.

Leo: will PR routing config by EOD.

Anya: perfect — will post playbook after meeting. :white_check_mark:
